Boundary share is resolvable and NOT small: boundary-only reading still ~-11% > 3%.
phase_a_reestimate.corrected_expectation: -9.5%..-22% wall on R4, center -17.7% (P2 = vec_busy 2.20 measured + flat-form overhead 0.05-0.15 + marginal residual 0.66-0.90 anchored to R6 flat noncausal measured P6=3.35/vec=2.69; fill' 8-11; launch 2.9)
phase_a_reestimate.iter4_correction_applied: the falsified 'wall = busy + round-trip residual' model was NOT reused: C2 does not touch gating depth (ns=2 slots + single release tokens + G1-first inherited verbatim), it removes BATCH-GRAIN data-dependency idles — the mechanism class empirically adopted twice in this family (iter2 ns1->flat -23.3%; iter3 R6 A/B -14.7%). Break-even would need the flat residual to inflate 1.7x over its measured noncausal value.
phase_a_reestimate.actual_vs_expected: R4 measured -9.18% landed at the CONSERVATIVE edge of the range (188.1us predicted conservative vs 187.97 measured). Post-hoc attribution: vec busy rose +9.3us (2.20->2.38/kv) in flat form (per-task neg_sm cap refill + AO-head fills + FIN cadence; attribution INFERENCE), consuming ~half of the exposure reduction (89.8->61.4us). The direction and mechanism matched; the vec-overhead term was underestimated.

design.stream: u = 2*t + kv (U = 2*mc). C pair-step: G1(t,kv1) -> G2(t,kv0) -> Qload(t+1) -> G1(t+1,kv0) -> G2(t,kv1) (G1-first per iter4). V pair-beat: AO(t,kv0) -> SM(t+1,kv0) -> AO(t,kv1) -> FIN(t) -> SM(t+1,kv1) (kv1-flat AO->FIN->SM(+2) offset generalized; FIN only at task tails; next task's kv0 softmax runs AHEAD of current FIN).
design.state_slots_REDERIVED_for_kv2: acc_o/sumexp: TASK-parity (idx (t%2)*2+h) — the intra-task AO(kv0)->AO(kv1) rescale chain is a REAL value chain and must stay in one slot across 2 u (kv1's u-parity==task-parity degeneracy no longer holds; u-parity would read a stale slot = silent precision corruption). sumexp_is/r_factors: KV-parity (idx (u%2)*2+h == g2stack i*2+h) — SM(u) write -> AO(u) read -> SM(u+2) overwrite window is program-order safe in the V-serial stream. neg_sm: g2stack h*2+cur semantics + WHOLE-BUFFER cap refill at SM(t,kv0) head (exactly g2stack's per-task fill value/position; prv-slot-only refill rejected as unneeded divergence). Per-task acc_o/sumexp fills at AO(t,kv0) head ([S3-iter2-B fix] pattern — fills NEVER removed; NaN discipline). UB/L1/L0/GM-ws footprint: ZERO increment vs flat kv1 (acc_o[4,half,D] etc. same shapes).
design.q_protocol: the ONE new local handshake (q_l1 read by 2 consecutive G1s, reloaded per task): G1(kv0) waits the MTE2->MTE1 full token; G1(kv1) skips the wait (content resident — C-stream serial issue guarantees no intervening Qload) and is the SOLE MTE1->MTE2 free-token setter (SetFlag drains the in-order MTE1 queue => one token implies BOTH reads complete). Qload waits 1 free / sets 1 full; init free x1, destroy x1 — counts and pending depth IDENTICAL to shipped flat kv1. FIRST ATTEMPT used a double set/wait pair (init x2, both G1s set, Qload waits x2) and DEADLOCKED at the prologue Qload (aicore timeout 507014 on the mc2 smoke) — see framework_findings[0].
design.gating_inheritance: cross ids 0-5 unchanged (zero new; 6-10 spare untouched), init tokens unchanged (C: WS2_C2V x1; V: WS1_V2C x1, WS3_V2C x1 — SINGLE-token release pacing, hard constraint 1), per-u set/wait counts mirror kv1-flat with mc->U, FIFO effective gates SM(u)<-G1(u) / G1(u)<-SM(u-1) / SM(u)<-G2(u-1) / G2(u)<-AO(u-1) / AO(u)<-G2(u). Pending depth <= 3 cross, <= 1 local (<= 6 safety bound).

measurements.mechanism_conclusion: AS DESIGNED, with the iter4 signature rotation reproduced: the batch-alternation data-ready waits COLLAPSED (R4 C_id2 109.8->31.0 = -72%, V_id4 106.2->30.2 = -72%; c7 same -65%/-56%) and the waits MIGRATED to the release/pacing side (C_id1 +100.6, V_id3 +103.0) — i.e. the kernel is now pacing-bound exactly like the proven kv1 flat (whose signature is C-id1/V-id3 dominant). Boundary exposure did NOT vanish into thin air: exposure/kv fell 1.726 -> 1.181 (R4) while vec busy ROSE 114.4 -> 123.7us (+0.18/kv flat-form overhead: per-task neg_sm cap refill + AO-head fills + per-2u FIN cadence — attribution INFERENCE from busy-time deltas, no instruction trace). Net wall -19.0us = exposure -28.4us + vec +9.3us. The load-bearing pacing gates (single-token id1/id3) were inherited untouched and now carry the residual waits WITHOUT the iter4-style latency inflation — because run-ahead depth is unchanged (unlike the ns4 arm), only the handoff granularity changed.

framework_findings: (NEW, load-bearing) LOCAL set_flag/wait_flag event ids do NOT reliably stack tokens: the first Q-protocol attempt (init x2 sets + Qload double-wait on one local id) DEADLOCKED at the prologue (aicore timeout 507014), while the identical stacking on CROSS sems was empirically fine (iter4 ns4 arm, 4 tokens). Whether local events are binary or shallow-counting was not isolated; the safe form (now shipped) is strict depth-1 ping-pong: the LAST MTE1 reader of q_l1 (the kv1 G1) is the sole free-token setter — SetFlag drains the in-order MTE1 queue, so ONE token implies both reads completed. Every shipped local protocol in this repo is depth-1; keep it that way.

(harness) gqa() has TWO dispatch caches: _KERNEL_BUILD_CACHE (spec chain) AND the adapter-level _COMPILED_CACHE (shape -> resolved _run). Monkeypatch probes MUST clear both, else a pre-patch kernel_fn silently survives into the patched run (observed: 'variant factory NEVER invoked' on a shape whose _run was cached).

(perf principle, measured) Batch-grain -> u-grain handoff conversion is a REAL lever (-9.2%/-7.3%) even with gating depth untouched — it is orthogonal to iter4's falsified ring-depth lever. The gain nets against a +0.18us/kv vec-busy rise from the flat form's per-task state hygiene (refill/fill ops); future kv2-domain work should attack that overhead if more is needed.

(data quality, reproduced) impossible single-block PipeUtilization rows appear sporadically (iter4: r3_g2first_s2; iter5: c7_base_s5) — always sanity-filter per-core times against TaskDur before aggregation.
